meta.title: Anak Krakatau — Live Status
meta.description: Current alert level, ash advisories, and eruption timeline for Anak Krakatau, Indonesia.

disclaimer.text: Unofficial. Always follow MAGMA Indonesia, BMKG, and BNPB.

status.heading: Current status
status.hazardRadius: Stay {km} km from the active crater
status.hazardRadiusUnknown: Exclusion radius not stated in the latest report.
status.observationPeriodUnknown: Observation period not stated in the latest report.
status.ashHeightUnreadable: We could not read the ash-cloud height from the latest notice. This does not mean no ash cloud was reported.
status.ashAirspaceActive: An ash SIGMET is in force for the airspace — see the ash direction map.

mask.title: Wear a proper mask
mask.body: Use an N95 or KN95 mask outdoors. A cloth mask does not stop volcanic ash.

indoors.title: Close up the house
indoors.body: Shut windows, doors, and vents. Keep pets inside.

water.title: Cover water and food
water.body: Cover open water tanks and wash produce before eating.

driving.title: Drive slowly or not at all
driving.body: Ash makes roads slippery and cuts visibility. Do not use wipers on dry ash.

contact.title: Emergency contacts
contact.body: BNPB call centre 117. Local BPBD for evacuation information.

map.heading: Ash direction
map.noSector: The latest notice reports no observed ash cloud, so no direction is drawn.
map.directionUnreadable: We could not read a drift direction from the latest notice, so none is drawn. This does not mean no ash cloud was reported.
map.legendHazard: Red ring: the official exclusion radius stated in the PVMBG report.
map.renderUnavailable: The map could not be drawn on this device. That says nothing about the volcano — the drift direction is described below and in the original notice.
map.legendSigmet: Shaded area: airspace carrying volcanic ash, as stated in the official SIGMET. Not a forecast of ashfall on the ground.
map.sigmetNone: No volcanic-ash SIGMET is in force for Anak Krakatau right now.
map.sigmetGroundCaveat: A SIGMET describes airspace, not ashfall where you are standing.

coastal.heading: If you are on the coast
coastal.history: Anak Krakatau's deadliest event was not ashfall. On 22 December 2018 part of its flank collapsed into the sea, and the tsunami killed 437 people along the Banten and Lampung coasts.
coastal.noWarning: That wave arrived without a felt earthquake. The collapse produced no strong shaking, so the warning systems did not detect it and no alert was issued. Do not wait to feel an earthquake.
coastal.action: If the sea suddenly draws far back, or you hear a loud boom from the strait, move away from the shore to higher ground immediately and stay there until BMKG says it is safe.
coastal.authority: This dashboard does not monitor tsunami risk. Tsunami warnings for Indonesia are issued by BMKG — follow BMKG and your local BPBD.
